subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b974fdc8df4ad8065638eb5fc6e8c8d02c3b59342c9d8e334a88d3e093a73fc3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) For the left top number series → Increasing squares of the number series pattern are followed here. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fc1fc5ccef05fbce53468c9ddba19b3b94c3878ceebf985723109118ac0e647.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e5526b78a9d932ba8a7c7b518239597982709aa174481a44a5ccca969ac6702.png] 

2) For the left bottom corner number series → (1) is added to each number subsequently. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1496244bc67afce4038e8631f7f6982deefb0970df7d3d093223dfd13e527a42.png] 

3) For the right corner number series → Consecutive multiples of (2) are added to each number subsequently. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daa95b8c8fa63dbec00d11715afa873e3da25f178b379e1abf8186517a66cd0f.png] 

4) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc91b99286024e2d8f9d6078c50ea831de0d1bfa27ac7284b0f0e70258754f03.png] ' element → No change. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c610ddcaecb639c5cc83cdec144b9ed566f92373680200ab05e39256c0ce2d.png] 

 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c610ddcaecb639c5cc83cdec144b9ed566f92373680200ab05e39256c0ce2d.png] 

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
